Director, Commercial Training & Sales Enablement (CTSE)
description:
**Req \#** 209701 **Location** Roma, Lazio, Italy **Additional locations** Reading, Berkshire; Madrid, Madrid; Warsaw, Masovian **Job Category** Commercial Operations **Date posted** 09/17/2026
  
**This is where** your work makes a difference.


At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.


Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.


Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

**Summary**


The Director, Commercial Training \& Sales Enablement (CTSE) is responsible for the strategic leadership, development, execution, and continuous improvement of commercial training and sales enablement initiatives supporting enterprise business responsibility for commercial training in the Western Europe (WEU) Business and also including CEEMEA for Advanced Surgery.


This role serves as the commercial capability leader for the business, responsible for building and executing comprehensive learning and sales enablement strategies that accelerate sales team effectiveness, leadership capability, product adoption, customer engagement, and business performance. The Director leads commercial training strategy and deployment across the entire employee lifecycle, including onboarding, product and clinical education, sales methodology, leadership development, launch readiness, ongoing capability development, and performance advancement.


The role engages with leaders at all levels from the President of each business through to individual contributors, and is a standing business partner and consultant of the leadership teams within the entire geography listed above and sits on the Global CTSE Leadership Team. Working closely with Commercial Leadership, Global and Regional Marketing, Clinical, Medical, Human Resources, and Global CTSE partners, this individual will influence strategic priorities, identify capability gaps, capture data and analytics, and develop scalable learning solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.


The Director will lead a team of training professionals and manage training investments, resources, and external partners to ensure successful execution of business priorities across the region supporting \~500 sales employees in the region including sales leaders and sales representatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Commercial Training \& Enablement Strategy**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial training and sales enablement strategy aligned to global CTSE pillars and enterprise business objectives across the WEU markets
* Partner with senior commercial leadership to assess organizational capabilities, identify performance gaps, and prioritize development initiatives
* Create and maintain a multi\-year capability roadmap that supports business growth, product innovation, market expansion, and changing customer needs
* Ensure training and sales enablement priorities are aligned with global capability frameworks, standards, and strategic initiatives
* Act as the primary strategic advisor to business leaders on capability development, learning effectiveness, and sales readiness

**Sales Force \& Leadership Development**

* Lead development and execution of training programs in conjunction with the global COE in CTSE. Programs will support sales representatives, sales leaders, clinical specialists, and channel partners
* Oversee new hire onboarding and certification programs to accelerate time\-to\-productivity
* Assess need for and implement sales leadership development programs focused on coaching, talent development, execution excellence, and performance management
* Drive adoption and reinforcement of selling methodology, customer engagement strategies, and commercial best practices
* Ensure field teams possess the product, clinical, market, competitive, and selling capabilities required to achieve business objectives and oversee certification processes, implementation, and outcomes

**Launch Readiness \& Business Transformation**

* Partner with Global and Regional Marketing, Medical Affairs, and Commercial Leadership to develop and execute launch readiness strategies
* Ensure field readiness for new products, services, digital solutions, and strategic initiatives
* Lead organizational change management and capability\-building efforts associated with commercial transformation initiatives
* Implement innovative learning technologies and approaches that improve learner engagement, retention, coaching, and performance

**Stakeholder Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organization, including senior executives and Business Unit leadership
* Serve as a key member of business planning and leadership forums to ensure capability implications are incorporated into strategic decisions
* Influence and align cross\-functional stakeholders around capability priorities, resource allocation, and enablement strategies
* Collaborate with Global CTSE teams to ensure consistency, scalability, and sharing of best practices

**Training Effectiveness \& Analytics**

* Partner with the Global CTSE Center of Excellence (COE) to establish and monitor metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, field readiness, learning adoption, and business impact
* Partner with CTSE COE to map curriculum and learning assets against business needs to develop the right learning pathways by role and business
* Utilize data and performance insights to continuously improve learning programs and capability initiatives
* Monitor and share dashboards with regional leadership demonstrating the value and impact of training investments
* Leverage analytics to identify capability gaps and emerging development opportunities

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team currently including five Senior Training Managers
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Establish clear objectives, development plans, and success measures for team members
* Build organizational capability and succession pipelines to support future business needs

**Financial \& Operational Leadership**

* Develop and manage annual operating plans and budgets for training and sales enablement initiatives
* Ensure effective prioritization and allocation of resources to maximize business impact
* Manage business\-related vendor partnerships and learning solutions while collaborating with senior leadership on broader vendor governance
* Oversee planning and execution of major training events, sales meetings, national training meetings, leadership development programs, and field\-based learning experiences

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success leading commercial training, sales enablement, sales effectiveness, or capability development organizations
* Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior leaders in a complex, matrixed environment
* Strong strategic planning, business acumen, and organizational capability development expertise
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and driving organizational change
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable business insights
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, and build high\-performing organizations
* Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and adapt to evolving business needs
* Experience implementing innovative learning technologies, digital learning strategies, and modern enablement solutions
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% across the region of responsibility

**Preferred Capabilities**

* Commercial capability strategy and workforce development planning
* Sales methodology implementation and reinforcement
* Leadership development and coaching program implementation
* Learning impact analysis and performance consulting
* Launch readiness and commercial execution planning
* Change management and transformation leadership
* Learning technology, LMS, and digital learning ecosystem expertise
* AI\-enabled learning, coaching, and sales enablement solution experience
* Vendor management and learning partner oversight
* Executive stakeholder engagement and influence

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Education, Marketing, Life Sciences, Organizational Development, or a related field
* Advanced degree (MBA, Master's in Learning \& Development, Organizational Leadership, or related discipline) preferred
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in commercial training, sales enablement, sales leadership, commercial excellence, or related healthcare industry roles
* Experience in medical device, healthcare technology, diagnostics, life sciences, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred
* Prior people leadership experience managing professional\-level teams preferred
* Demonstrated success leading regional or multi\-business commercial capability initiatives preferred


We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The minimum salary for this position is €112,000 annually. Your initial pay could be at the minimum or higher based on skills, expertise, experience, and other relevant factors, all of which are subject to change. This position may also be eligible for competitive benefits, discretionary bonuses, incentives, and/or long\-term incentive. For questions about our pay philosophy and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**


Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

**Reasonable Accommodations**  

  

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

**Recruitment Fraud Notice**  

  

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

title: Bid & Commercial Coordinator
description:
Avincis is one of the world’s leading Emergency Aerial Service Operators and the largest in Europe. We operate from more than 180 bases across Spain, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Greece, Mozambique and Chile. We operate a fleet of approximately 205 aircraft which includes 165 helicopters and 40 aeroplanes.

We oversee our global operations from Lisboa, Portugal and count on a team of more than 2,400 courageous and talented professionals, including pilots, crews, technicians and support teams to deliver this unique service.

In Italy we have 42 Operational Bases, approximately 742 dedicated personnel and approximately 64 aircraft. We provide Helicopter Emergency Medical Services (HEMS), Search and Rescue (SAR), Firefighting (FF) Offshore and Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO)

For our Italian branch, we are looking for a **Bid \& Commercial coordinator**, who will support the Bid Manager and the HEMS Commercial Manager in bid and contract management activities. The position offers opportunities for professional growth through increasing autonomy, responsibility, and accountability over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor market surveys and tender/bid publications on a regular basis
* Ensure the timely distribution of bid documentation to all relevant stakeholders
* Support the Bid Manager in the preparation of bid\-related meetings (e.g. Kick\-off, Daily Check\-ins, Governance reviews)
* Contribute to bid competitiveness analyses and economic evaluations in collaboration with key stakeholders
* Support the timely and accurate preparation of complete bid packages, including administrative, technical, and commercial documentation
* Ensure contract requirements are clearly communicated, properly understood, and implemented by key stakeholders
* Support the HEMS Commercial Manager in managing and continuously improving customer relationships
* Monitor and track contract performance (e.g. financial, operational) through defined KPIs
* Contribute to contract performance continuous improvement initiatives through planning, control actions, and adherence to project management standards
* Prepare periodic and ad hoc contract performance reports

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
* At least 3 years of experience in bid and contract management, preferably involving government or public sector tenders
* Strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Proficiency in spoken and written Italian and English
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Highly structured, detail oriented, and data focused approach combined with a proactive attitude.
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Previous experience in the aeronautical/aerospace/defence industry

title: Executive Assistant to the CTO
description:
**About us:**



The physical and digital worlds are merging. Vehicles, medical devices, industrial systems, critical infrastructure: security hasn't kept pace. AI is accelerating everything, from the capabilities of the systems we depend on to the sophistication of the threats targeting them. A software vulnerability can now have physical consequences. A physical breach can compromise entire digital ecosystems. Billions of devices operate with little to no protection, and traditional approaches can't keep up. Not at this scale, not at this speed, and not across this diversity of systems.  

Exein exists to solve this. We build the security layer for a world where physical and digital threats are no longer separate problems, from kernel\-level runtime protection on embedded devices to cloud\-native platforms that analyze, protect, and prove compliance across entire device fleets. We're not patching the old model. We're building security from the core out.

  


**Job Overview**



We are seeking a high\-trust, proactive **Executive Assistant** to act as a strategic operational partner to our **CTO** across global time zones (EMEA, US, APAC). In this role, you will take full ownership of complex calendar prioritization, end\-to\-end travel logistics, inbox triaging, and high\-stakes communications—drafting replies directly in the CTO's voice while maintaining absolute discretion over confidential matters (M\&A, hiring, comp). From preparing meeting briefs to coordinating board events and chasing leadership follow\-ups, you will keep the CTO focused and operating at peak efficiency.  

The ideal candidate brings 3\+ years of experience supporting founders or C\-suite executives in fast\-paced environments. You thrive under ambiguity, exercise sharp judgment without hand\-holding, and communicate with exceptional conciseness. Highly fluent in Google Workspace, Slack, and modern AI tools, you combine low ego with high standards to solve problems before they reach the CTO's desk.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Own the CTO's calendar: scheduling, prioritization, protecting focus time across EMEA, US and APAC time zones
* Organize travel end to end: flights, hotels, logistics, changes on the fly
* Triage inbox and messages; draft replies and follow\-ups in his voice
* Prepare meetings: agendas, briefs, background on people and companies
* Chase follow\-ups and open threads across the leadership team
* Coordinate internal events, offsites and board meeting logistics
* Handle confidential material (hiring, comp, M\&A) with full discretion
* Occasional personal scheduling where it intersects with work commitments.

  


**Requirements:**


* Judgment under ambiguity: you make dozens of small calls a day without checking in, and you get them right
* Proactive ownership: you notice problems and fix them before anyone asks
* Absolute discretion with sensitive information
* Sharp, concise written communication that can pass as the CTO's own
* Low ego, high standards: the job is invisible when done well
* Fluent with Google Workspace, Slack and modern AI tools
* 3\+ years supporting a founder or C\-level executive preferred
* Italian and English fluency is required; Mandarin is a plus

  


**Why Join Us?**


* We're a mission\-led team solving tough, meaningful problems
* You'll have autonomy and impact from Day 1
* We're growing fast—which means so will your opportunities

  


**Location:** Rome \- regular in\-office presence expected \- Piazzale Flaminio 19, 00196


**Salary range**: €30K \- 40K

  


*Exein is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate all applications fairly regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, background, or orientation.*

title: Manager, Regulatory and PV Delivery
description:
**Company Description**  

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.


At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.


We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post\-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.


That work takes curious minds, problem\-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.


If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**  

The Manager, Regulatory and PV Delivery is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan. They actively assist senior management in securing new business by participating to BDMs and  

contributing to proposals/budgets. They also provide strategic regulatory guidance, training, coaching and mentoring to junior members; may be required to line manage members of staff.


Main responsibilities:

* Assume leadership and functional representation for projects and/or deliverables of high complexity ensuring effective and rapid coordination and management and execution of regulatory tasks, driving the team to meet the agreed targets and to comply with the agreed procedures, trackers and templates.
* Provide strategic input to internal and external customers and promptly identify and address any risk/potential risk by implementing preventive measures. Problem solve and ensure satisfactory resolution of performance issues or delivery failures.
* Provide expert advice to Clients addressing complex queries and changes in local regulations/guidance.
* Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify and escalate any OoS.
* Assist in securing new business or repeated business by participating to BDMs, developing and reviewing regulatory sections of proposals, regulatory costing and budgets.
* Prepare client’s invoices and review/approve vendor’s project invoices
* Provide training, coaching and mentoring to junior members of staff
* Support client qualification activities. Ensure audit readiness and assign team members to participate as departmental representatives for audits/inspections and provide responses to any findings/follow up questions.
* Prepare and/or contribute to the Regulatory Newsletter and update regulatory database  

when new information is available.
* Ensure collection, QC review and timely dissemination of all regulatory intelligence related to  

departmental deliverables. Support interpretation and impact analysis on legislation.
* Foster professional working relationships with internal and external contacts at the local and international levels to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery
* Drive department / company initiatives, act as a change champion and successfully manage implementation of the changes (communication, timing and implementation plan)

  

**Qualifications**  

* Minimum 3 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body, of which at least 3 years in a leading/project management role.
* Proven ability to successfully manage global projects.
* Expert knowledge of ICH GCP and/or GVP and most relevant legislation/ local requirements for territories of competency.

  

**Additional Information** **Why PrimeVigilance**


When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.


We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.


We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Head of Biologics Discovery
description:
**Ref. 209 S**
**Head of Biologics Discovery**
===============================


**Translational \& Discovery Research**
IRBM is a scientific contract research organization (CRO) that stands at the forefront of drug discovery, leveraging a single, unified research facility, located in Pomezia (Rome), Italy, to accelerate team\-based breakthroughs and improve efficiencies from initial concept to pre\-clinical candidate.


With a history of contributing to several approved drugs, and its own internal pipeline of oncology and other therapeutic assets, IRBM is powered by deep collaborations and decades of expertise from leading global institutions. Our comprehensive in\-house capabilities assist partners in achieving key milestones and progressing towards clinical readiness, positioning IRBM as a major player in driving innovation in the pharmaceutical and biotech fields.


**Job Description**


IRBM is seeking an experienced and highly motivated scientist to lead and expand its Biologics Discovery activities. The successful candidate will provide scientific and operational leadership for antibody discovery programs while supporting the growth of IRBM’s biologics capabilities and service offerings. This position combines scientific leadership, team development, client interaction and business support within a highly collaborative drug discovery environment. The role is ideally suited to a scientist who combines strong technical expertise in antibody discovery with a pragmatic and entrepreneurial mindset. In addition to supporting client programs, the successful candidate will have opportunities to contribute to internal scientific initiatives, technology development efforts and strategic research collaborations that complement IRBM’s discovery activities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead IRBM’s biologics discovery activities with a focus on therapeutic monoclonal antibodies.
* Provide scientific leadership for antibody discovery, engineering and characterization programs.
* Expand and strengthen biologics capabilities, including: Hybridoma\-based monoclonal antibody generation; Single B\-cell cloning and antibody recovery; Phage display technologies; Antibody engineering, humanization and affinity maturation; Recombinant antibody expression and characterization; Functional and developability assessment.
* Contribute to integrated biologics programs involving therapeutic antibodies, antibody\-drug conjugates (ADCs) and other emerging biologics modalities.
* Identify and evaluate new technologies that strengthen IRBM’s biologics offering and support client needs.
* Lead, mentor and develop a growing team of scientists.
* Support client interactions, proposal preparation and business development activities.
* Collaborate closely with colleagues across Biology, Protein Sciences, Structural Biology, Medicinal Chemistry, Peptide Chemistry, DMPK and Translational Research.
* Contribute to internal research initiatives, technology platforms and strategic scientific collaborations.
* Support the scientific strategy and long\-term growth of IRBM’s biologics capabilities.
  

**Competencies/skills**


* The successful candidate will be a collaborative scientific leader with a passion for developing people, building capabilities and delivering high\-quality science.
* The ideal candidate will combine scientific rigor with a practical, solution\-oriented mindset and will be comfortable operating at the interface between research, clients and business development.
* Strong leadership, communication and mentoring skills, together with a commitment to scientific excellence, innovation and teamwork, will be essential for success in this role
  

**Qualifications**


Required


* PhD or equivalent degree in Immunology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in biologics or antibody discovery.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more antibody discovery technologies, including hybridoma generation, phage display and/or single B\-cell cloning.
* Strong understanding of antibody engineering, characterization and developability.
* Experience leading scientists and managing research projects.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary and client\-focused environment.

Preferred


* Experience with antibody\-drug conjugates (ADCs) and related biologics\-based therapeutic modalities.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary environments combining biologics, chemistry, DMPK and translational sciences.
* Experience with bispecific antibodies, multi\-specific antibodies and other next\-generation antibody formats.
* Experience supporting client\-facing research activities within biotechnology, pharmaceutical or CRO environments.
* Track record of scientific achievement demonstrated through publications, patents and successful research programs.
* providing scientists with opportunities to contribute both to client success and to the advancement of future drug discovery capabilities.
  

The position is based in Pomezia (RM).

  

**Salary Pay Range**


RAL 60’000 – 100’000


During the job interview, we will evaluate each candidate’s experience, and the job offer will be commensurate.


We thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
  

IRBM considers all qualified applicants without discrimination, including on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or other protected classes. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone can show their full potential and enjoy a fulfilling career

TYPE OF CONTRACT: Regular Consultant level II  

UNIT/DIVISION: Gender Protection and Inclusion Unit/ PO  

DUTY STATION (City, Country): Home based  

DURATION: 11 months**BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:**


In line with increasing donor expectations, emerging safeguarding standards across the humanitarian sector, and WFP's Strategic Plan 2026–2029 commitment to uphold zero tolerance for child exploitation, abuse and harm, this assignment will support the strengthening of WFP's approach to **child safeguarding**, while also advancing the integration of **child protection considerations into programme design and implementation**.


The Programme Policy Officer will lead the development and institutionalization of WFP's Child Safeguarding Framework, including the elaboration, consultation, approval and operationalization of the Executive Director's Circular on Child Safeguarding. The position will also provide technical support to strengthen child protection mainstreaming across selected programme areas, ensuring that WFP assistance is delivered in a safe, inclusive and child\-sensitive manner.


Sitting within the Design and Capacity Strengthening Team in GPI, the consultant will support corporate guidance, capacity strengthening, CSP design and country office support, with a particular focus on translating safeguarding commitments into operational practice.

**KEY** **ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES** **(not all\-inclusive):**


The assignment will be organized around four priority workstreams:

**Lead th****e development and operationalization of WFP's Child Safeguarding Framework**


Lead the drafting, revision, consultation, clearance and approval process for the Executive Director's Circular on Child Safeguarding.


Coordinate consultations with HQ divisions, Regional Bureaux, Country Offices and external stakeholders.


Develop supporting guidance, tools, SOPs and implementation materials required to operationalize the Circular.


Support the establishment of governance, accountability and implementation arrangements for child safeguarding.


Contribute to the development of corporate learning and awareness\-raising initiatives related to child safeguarding.


Support engagement with donors and partners on child safeguarding commitments and standards.

**Strengthen integration of Child Safeguarding and Child Protection Considerations into Programme Design**


Provide technical support to Country Offices on integrating child safeguarding and child protection considerations into programme design and implementation.


Support CSP development and review processes, including FAR roll\-outs, ensuring that relevant child protection risks, barriers and opportunities are reflected where appropriate.


Advise on child\-sensitive programme design across relevant programme areas, including school meals, resilience, emergency assistance and social protection.


Promote the use of integrated context and risk analyses to identify risks affecting children and opportunities to improve programme quality.

**Strengthen GPI Capacity and Learning**


Support the integration of child safeguarding and child protection considerations into People\-Centred Approaches (PCA) trainings and related capacity\-strengthening initiatives.


Deliver and support trainings on child safeguarding, child protection mainstreaming, safe referrals and people\-centred programming.


Work with Regional and Country Office GPI colleagues to identify capacity gaps and learning priorities.


Support the development of practical tools, guidance and learning materials for Country Offices and cooperating partners.

**Evidence, Learning and Partnerships**


Support the generation and dissemination of evidence on child safeguarding and child protection mainstreaming across WFP operations.


Strengthen collaboration with specialized child protection actors, UN agencies and NGOs.


Contribute to the integration of child safeguarding and child protection considerations in corporate frameworks, including FAR and GPI minimum standards.


Support learning and exchange between Country Offices on good practices and operational innovations.

**DELIVERABLES AT THE END OF THE CONTRACT:**


The deliverables will be confirmed at the beginning of the assignment to ensure they match the latest developments, and will include:

* Executive Director's Circular on Child Safeguarding finalized and approved.
* Child protection considerations integrated into relevant GPI frameworks, including minimum standards and FAR.
* Technical support provided to CSP development and review processes on child safeguarding and child protection mainstreaming.
* PCA and other relevant GPI training materials updated to reflect child safeguarding and child protection considerations.

**QUALIFICATIONS \&** **EXPERIENCE** **REQUIRED:**

**Education:**


A postgraduate qualification in development studies, gender, international development, sociology other development\-related fields.

**Experience:**


At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in protection, of which at least 5 years are focused on providing technical assistance, programme design, implementation, monitoring, reporting, or evidence generation on child protection.


Previous experience working in emergency and humanitarian settings.


Previous exposure to WFP operations, including providing technical GPI support.


Experience in working on policies desirable.

**Knowledge \& Skills:**

* Proactive attitude, with initiative and a sense of accountability. Ability to provide technical advice that is actionable and can be understood by diverse stakeholders. Ability to develop user\-friendly guidance. Team player. Excellent interpersonal, communication and facilitation skills (written and oral). Ability to work productively and in an organized fashion.

**Languages:**


 English is required, French is desirable.

**WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK**

  

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

 **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION**

  

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org

**NO FEE DISCLAIMER**

  

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

 **REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION**

* All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.
* We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.
* If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is **only** for technical issues with an application \- **unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply**.
* At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.
* Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

*All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.*

 *No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.*

title: Head of Tender
description:
Work Your Magic with us!

  

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

  

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

 **Your Role**


As Tender Lead, you drive the end\-to\-end management of hospital product tenders. You scout opportunities, analyze complex bids, and formulate winning strategies. By leading cross\-functional alignment across Market Access, Commercial, Legal, Finance, Medical, and Supply Chain, you ensure fully compliant proposals. You manage the tender calendar, pipeline, and KPI dashboards—tracking win rates and regional performance—to enable data\-driven decisions. You lead negotiations with contracting authorities, monitor updates to the Public Procurement Code, and translate regulatory changes into actionable guidance. Moreover, you spearhead the internalization and optimization of tender operations, leading and developing your team to elevate standards and maximize efficiency.

 **Who You Are**

* Degree in Science, Economics, Supply Chain, or Law (Procurement context preferred).
* 8\+ years in pharma, with 3\-5 years managing complex hospital tenders.
* Deep expertise in the National Health System and Public Procurement Code.
* Proven team leader skilled at setting goals and developing professional talent.
* Analytical thinker capable of managing KPI dashboards and competitor insight.
* Proactive negotiator with strong cross\-functional stakeholder skills.

 **Salary Package:**

* Annual Base Salary (RAL): €70\.000 – €90\.000
* Categoria CCNL: A
* Variable Compensation (AIP)
* Welfare and Benefits Package
 **What we offer:** We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

  

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
